annotations.title: Set UTMs / tracking on a Google Ads campaign, ad group or ad

description: Set the FINAL URL SUFFIX (the UTMs added to every click), tracking template and custom parameters on a Google Ads campaign, ad group or ad; a lower level overrides a higher one. "" clears a field; utmDefault:true applies our standard UTMs (utm_source=google, utm_medium, utm_campaign=<name>, utm_id={campaignid}, utm_content={creative}). New campaigns already get those unless you say otherwise. Read back from Google.

adGroupId.description: ad group to set tracking on; use with level adGroup

adId.description: ad to set tracking on; use with level ad

campaignId.description: campaign to set tracking on; use with level campaign

confirm.description: needed to change the tracking redirect on a LIVE campaign

customerId.description: 10-digit account id; omit to use the brand's selected default account

dryRun.description: true = validate with Google and change nothing

finalUrlSuffix.description: UTM string appended to every click, e.g. utm_source=google&utm_medium=cpc; empty string clears it

loginCustomerId.description: manager (MCC) account id when acting through a manager account; omit otherwise

trackingUrlTemplate.description: click-tracking redirect template, e.g. {lpurl}?src=x; empty string clears it

urlCustomParameters.description: up to 8 custom URL parameters as a key/value object, used in URLs as {_key}

utmDefault.description: true = apply the standard UTMs (utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, utm_id, utm_content)

name: set_google_ads_tracking
title: Set UTMs / tracking on a Google Ads campaign, ad group or ad
